control_sampling: Simple size controls: uniform permutation of P. Mean-matched controls: D-only symmetric group-membership swaps initialized at real D group, constrained mean +/-tolerance, burn-in exactly10*size proposals; >=size accepted swaps qualifies without extending burn-in. Keep every size-proposal scheduled draw including rejections/self-loops/repeats; qualify whole chain by final initial Jaccard<=0.5 (never filter individual draws). MCMC approximation; samples correlated and global constrained-state mixing not established. V-missing controls are never redrawn; any inadequate group makes strict T_b undefined.
independence: Exposed within-bin blocks; original-document independence UNKNOWN
T_a_direction: D nontrivial groups matched one-to-one to V nontrivial groups; unmatched D=0

config.authorization: Current user explicitly requested execution, hypothesis checks, five figures and analysis. Scope: cached H1 structural/frequency analysis only; H2 learning is planning only.
config.mean_match_method: D-only fixed-size within-mean-interval symmetric membership-swap MCMC; initialized at original D group; random member/nonmember proposals; reject outside target D mean +/- tolerance; no V selection
config.mean_match_missing_rule: Preserve every D non-singleton group. Undefined observed or any null T_b under common coverage rule makes primary H1b calibration insufficient. No selective null filtering or resampling.
config.display_group_rule: D size descending, stable IDs and deterministic per-group hash quotas

null.p_values: Approximate conditional calibration only; no guaranteed FWER with MCMC draws. If mixing/coverage fails, no primary p-values.
null.stop_rule: Stop null inference on qualification failure or budget. Preserve diagnostics; continue bounded descriptive figures and factual records.
null.comparison_rule: last two checkpoints and between-chain final summaries: abs difference <= max(absolute floor,0.1*max(abs(a),abs(b),0.02)); endpoints floor0.02, overlap/phi floor0.01. Necessary diagnostics, not a mixing proof.

config.practical_effect_thresholds: UNKNOWN: report effect size/uncertainty, no researcher-confirmed scientific PASS or practical-equivalence claim.
config.independence: exposed D/V within same bin; original documents/near duplicates UNKNOWN
config.mean_match_burnin_rule: Exactly10*size proposals including rejections; acceptance>=size is qualification only, not a random stopping time. Fixed proposal intervals preserve self-loops.
config.mean_match_jaccard_rule: Qualification of whole matched chain after fixed burn-in, not individual draw rejection. Retain all scheduled draws including repeats. If chain insufficient, entire group match insufficient.

sampling_correction.basis: Pre-endpoint reasoning audit: sampling after fixed accepted swaps creates an acceptance-biased jump chain. Formal retention must use fixed proposals including rejected self-loops. Qualification accepted-count checkpoints remain diagnostic only.
